import sys
input=sys.stdin.readline

N,W=map(int,input().split())
cols=[[] for _ in range(W)]
for i in range(N):
    x,y=map(int,input().split())
    cols[x-1].append((y,i))
for col in cols:
    col.sort()

INF=10**30
death=[INF]*N
m=min(len(col) for col in cols)
for k in range(m):
    t=max(cols[x][k][0] for x in range(W))
    for x in range(W):
        death[cols[x][k][1]]=t

Q=int(input())
out=[]
for _ in range(Q):
    t,a=map(int,input().split())
    out.append('Yes' if t < death[a-1] else 'No')
print('\n'.join(out))
